recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If implementers need the incubator content published, linked differently, or further refined, handle that as API Incubator work; do not change core solely for FHIR-47468 while the external source already carries the requested parameters.
issue_request: FHIR-47468 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by FHIR-I to add optional async-bulk kick-off query parameters, `_minimumFileSize` and `_maximumFileSize`, so clients can request generated NDJSON files within preferred size bounds. The resolution requires positive integer values, `_maximumFileSize` greater than `_minimumFileSize` when both are present, server conformance expectations for lower/upper bounds, and implementation notes for defaults, necessary deviations, and documented fixed bounds.
initial_application: HL7/fhir pull request #3214 applied the issue: commit a613c0bff23537722fa4f68f65f56dfa6ddc337d added the two parameter bullets and implementation notes to `source/async-bulk.html`, and merge commit a3e413fdf1661c8f6a0bcfdb644f2ccb91c7bf93 merged that change into core.
additional_context: Later R6 normative work in commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd deleted `source/async-bulk.html` and `source/async-bundle.html` from core and changed `source/async.html` to point readers to the API Incubator while the details are finalized through implementation testing. The external HL7/api-incubator-ig source file `input/pagecontent/async-bulk.html` contains the FHIR-47468 `_minimumFileSize` and `_maximumFileSize` bullets and implementation notes. Sibling issue FHIR-47469 followed the same migration path for async-bulk output `filesize` and has already been audited separately on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. Restoring the old core page or duplicating the file-size parameters in `source/async.html` would conflict with the current source-scope decision to keep detailed async-bulk content in the API Incubator.
